title: Luffy's most embarrassing weakness

scenes.headline: Luffy's biggest weakness?
scenes.narration: Luffy can stretch like rubber and shrug off hits that would flatten anyone else. But he has one weakness that is almost embarrassing.
scenes.image_prompt: Monkey D. Luffy from One Piece, straw hat, red open vest, blue shorts, scar under left eye, huge confident grin, stretching his rubber arm far across a stormy sea from a pirate ship deck, giant crashing waves, lightning

scenes.headline: He can't swim. At all.
scenes.narration: He can't swim. At all. The Gum-Gum Fruit turned his body into rubber, but the price was brutal: like every Devil Fruit user, he can no longer swim.
scenes.image_prompt: a straw hat slowly sinking into the deep blue ocean, air bubbles rising, sunbeams piercing down from the surface far above

scenes.headline: A hat with a promise
scenes.narration: And that straw hat? Not a fashion choice. The pirate Shanks entrusted it to Luffy as a kid, and asked him to return it one day as a great pirate.
scenes.image_prompt: Shanks from One Piece, red-haired pirate captain with three scars over his left eye and a black cloak, gently placing his straw hat on the head of young crying Luffy, seaside village harbor at sunset, emotional

scenes.headline: King of the Pirates
scenes.narration: His dream has never changed: find the legendary treasure called the One Piece, and become King of the Pirates.
scenes.image_prompt: Monkey D. Luffy from One Piece in his straw hat standing on the bow of a pirate ship, fist raised triumphantly, golden light of a legendary treasure glowing on the horizon, epic sky

scenes.headline: Who do you save first?
scenes.narration: Quick question. The ship flips and you can only save one Straw Hat. Who are you saving? Tell me in the comments, and follow for more anime secrets.
scenes.image_prompt: silhouettes of a pirate crew on a ship with a straw hat jolly roger flag sailing toward a huge sunrise, wide shot, warm golden light

caption:
Luffy: survives literally everything 💪
Also Luffy: one splash of seawater 🫠🌊

The ship flips and you can only save ONE Straw Hat. Who are you saving? 👇
